title: AEO Tier-2 Status Administrative Framework
summary: The concept of Tier-2 status is defined within the AEO (Recognition and Management) Rules, 2024, as a transitional tier between Tier-1 and Tier-3. The evolution of this concept is characterized by the standardization of application forms and certification procedures across multiple administrative updates, maintaining a consistent legal basis under the 2024 Rules.

evolution.legal_basis: Remains anchored to the AEO (Recognition and Management) Rules, 2024 throughout the period.
evolution.procedure: Standardized application and certification forms (Form-J, Form-Jh, Form-T, Form-Th) remain consistent.

timeline.change: Initial establishment of Tier-2 application and certification procedures.

Applicants must fulfill requirements specified under the Authorized Economic Operator (Recognition and Operation) Rules, 2024, including proof of satisfactory performance during their period as a Tier-1 operator.

Authorized Economic Operator: This clause provides the formal application format (Form-T) for entities currently holding Tier-2 status to upgrade their certification to Tier-3 status.

Applicants must demonstrate a history of operations under Tier-2 status and provide evidence of a satisfactory audit as required by the Authorized Economic Operator (Recognition and Management) Rules, 2024.
The application process requires submitting the organization's name, address, Business Identification Number, details of the existing Tier-2 certificate, and the date of the most recent audit.
Business Identification Number: The Business Identification Number is a mandatory detail required to be submitted by an applicant seeking to upgrade to Tier-3 Authorized Economic Operator status.
Authorized Economic Operator (Recognitio: These rules establish the legal framework under which an entity may apply for and be granted Tier-3 Authorized Economic Operator status.
Rule 9(2) specifically outlines the provision for applying for Tier-3 recognition, while Rule 8(1) governs the operational duration requirement for existing Tier-2 status holders.

The application process allows existing Tier-1 operators who have successfully completed the required audit procedures to apply for a promotion to Tier-2 status.
